## SyncBatch weekly creatives (free models)
Runs **Mon & Thu 09:00 IST** with an **18:00 catch-up**.

Writers, tried in order (all free tiers):
1. **Gemini 3.8 Flash**
2. **Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite** (separate quota)
3. **Groq · GPT-OSS 120B** (different company)
4. **Backup bank** of 10 fact-checked posts

Each writer's 3 options are checked for repeats and unverifiable claims before use. The card (SyncBatch + INOVUS LABS logos) is rendered on the SyncBatch site; if that fails, captions go out text-only. Any crash → alerts workflow.

Edit the **Config** node first.

// Backup copy bank: used when every free model fails or none of their posts pass the checks.
// Every claim here is from the verified fact sheet. Each post is used once before the bank repeats.
const plan = $('Build prompt').first().json;
const err = $input.first().json.error;
const reason = (typeof err === 'string' ? err : err?.message) || 'unknown error';

const T = (o) => ({ points: [], before: '', after: '', cta: 'Try it free', ...o });
const BANK = [
  T({ id: 'fb-class-list', template: 'statement', eyebrow: 'For teachers', headline: 'Your class list, saved to your phone', highlight: 'in one go.', body: 'Upload the Excel sheet, check every number, and every student lands in your contacts.',
    instagram_caption: 'New class, 60 numbers to save. 😩\nUpload the Excel sheet to SyncBatch instead: check every number, then save them all to your phone at once.\nAndroid and iPhone. First 10 contacts free.\nLink in bio.',
    linkedin_post: 'Every new semester, I watched teachers type 60+ numbers into their phones one by one, just to make a class WhatsApp group.\n\nSo I built SyncBatch at INOVUS LABS: upload the class sheet, check every number in a preview, and save them all at once.\n\nAndroid and iPhone. First 10 contacts free.\n{LINK}',
    x_post: 'Class list in Excel? Save every number to your phone at once, then make the WhatsApp group. {LINK}',
    hashtags: { instagram: ['SyncBatch', 'InovusLabs', 'teachers', 'teacherlife', 'kerala', 'whatsapptips', 'productivity', 'edtech', 'studentstartup', 'excel'], linkedin: ['SyncBatch', 'InovusLabs', 'EdTech', 'BuildInPublic'], x: ['EdTech'] },
    alt_text: 'SyncBatch card: Your class list, saved to your phone in one go, with a list of contacts marked 58 contacts added.', angle_summary: 'teacher saves a whole class list to phone at once' }),
  T({ id: 'fb-whatsapp-tip', template: 'tip', eyebrow: 'Quick tip', headline: 'Numbers not showing in', highlight: 'WhatsApp?', body: 'WhatsApp only shows people saved in your phone, with the right country code.', points: ['SyncBatch adds +91 (or the country you pick) to every number, so they show up in WhatsApp.'],
    instagram_caption: 'Saved a number but it is not in WhatsApp? 🤔\nWhatsApp only shows contacts saved in your phone with the right country code.\nSyncBatch adds +91 (or your country) to every number in your sheet before saving.\nLink in bio.',
    linkedin_post: 'A small thing that breaks WhatsApp groups: numbers saved without a country code.\n\nSyncBatch adds +91 (or the country you pick) to every number in your spreadsheet before saving it to your phone, and removes leading zeros.\n{LINK}',
    x_post: 'Numbers missing in WhatsApp? Check the country code. SyncBatch adds it to a whole sheet at once. {LINK}',
    hashtags: { instagram: ['SyncBatch', 'InovusLabs', 'whatsapptips', 'techtips', 'androidtips', 'iphonetips', 'kerala', 'productivity'], linkedin: ['SyncBatch', 'InovusLabs', 'Productivity'], x: ['WhatsApp'] },
    alt_text: 'SyncBatch tip card: Numbers not showing in WhatsApp? SyncBatch adds the country code to every number.', angle_summary: 'country code tip so numbers appear in WhatsApp' }),
  T({ id: 'fb-fest', template: 'beforeafter', eyebrow: 'Event organisers', headline: 'Registration list to phone', highlight: 'before doors open.', body: 'Your whole team can call or WhatsApp any attendee.', before: 'Copying 120 numbers from a Google Form, one by one', after: 'One upload. Every attendee saved, duplicates skipped',
    instagram_caption: 'Fest registrations closed? 🎉\nExport the Google Form sheet, upload it to SyncBatch, and every attendee is saved on your phone. Duplicates skipped.\nLink in bio.',
    linkedin_post: 'Organising a fest or event? The registration sheet is usually a Google Form export with 100+ numbers.\n\nSyncBatch saves the whole sheet to your phone at once, skips duplicates, and lets you label everyone, e.g. "(Fest 2026)", so the list is easy to find and remove later.\n{LINK}',
    x_post: 'Event registration sheet → every attendee in your phone, duplicates skipped. {LINK}',
    hashtags: { instagram: ['SyncBatch', 'InovusLabs', 'eventplanning', 'collegefest', 'eventmanagement', 'kerala', 'googleforms', 'productivity'], linkedin: ['SyncBatch', 'InovusLabs', 'Events', 'Productivity'], x: ['Events'] },
    alt_text: 'SyncBatch card comparing copying 120 numbers one by one with one upload that saves every attendee.', angle_summary: 'event registration sheet saved to organiser phones before the event' }),
  T({ id: 'fb-steps', template: 'steps', eyebrow: 'How it works', headline: 'Excel to WhatsApp group', highlight: 'in 3 steps.', body: 'No typing, no app to install.', points: ['Upload your Excel or CSV', 'Check every number in the preview', 'Sync to Android or get a .vcf'],
    instagram_caption: 'Excel → phone → WhatsApp group, in 3 steps:\n1. Upload the sheet\n2. Check the preview\n3. Sync to Android, or download a .vcf for iPhone\nLink in bio.',
    linkedin_post: 'How SyncBatch works, in three steps:\n\n1. Upload an Excel or CSV file (or a public Google Sheets link)\n2. Check every contact in a preview: invalid numbers flagged, duplicates skipped\n3. Sync to Google Contacts on Android, or download one .vcf file for iPhone\n{LINK}',
    x_post: 'Excel → preview → phone contacts. Android or iPhone, no typing. {LINK}',
    hashtags: { instagram: ['SyncBatch', 'InovusLabs', 'howto', 'excel', 'whatsapptips', 'productivity', 'android', 'iphone', 'kerala'], linkedin: ['SyncBatch', 'InovusLabs', 'Productivity'], x: ['Productivity'] },
    alt_text: 'SyncBatch card: Excel to WhatsApp group in 3 steps: upload, check preview, sync.', angle_summary: 'three step overview of the whole flow' }),
  T({ id: 'fb-coaching', template: 'usecase', eyebrow: 'Coaching centres', headline: 'New batch every month?', highlight: 'Save them all at once.', body: 'Label each batch so you can find it, and remove it when the course ends.', points: ['Label like (JEE Batch 3)', 'Duplicates skipped', 'Remove the batch later'],
    instagram_caption: 'Running batches every month? 📚\nUpload the batch sheet, add a label like (JEE Batch 3), and save everyone at once. Remove the whole batch when the course ends.\nLink in bio.',
    linkedin_post: 'Coaching centres save a new batch of student and parent numbers every few weeks.\n\nWith SyncBatch you upload the sheet, add a label like "(JEE Batch 3)" to every name, and save them all at once. When the batch ends, upload the same sheet in delete mode to remove them.\n{LINK}',
    x_post: 'New batch every month? Save them with a label, remove them when the course ends. {LINK}',
    hashtags: { instagram: ['SyncBatch', 'InovusLabs', 'coachingcentre', 'tuition', 'teachers', 'kerala', 'education', 'productivity'], linkedin: ['SyncBatch', 'InovusLabs', 'Education'], x: ['Education'] },
    alt_text: 'SyncBatch card for coaching centres: label each batch, skip duplicates, remove the batch later.', angle_summary: 'coaching batches labelled and removed after the course' }),
  T({ id: 'fb-iphone', eyebrow: 'iPhone users', headline: 'One .vcf file for', highlight: 'the whole list.', body: 'Open it on your iPhone and iOS offers to add every contact at once.', points: ['No app to install: open the .vcf from AirDrop, Files or Mail.'],
    template: 'tip',
    instagram_caption: 'On iPhone? 🍏\nSyncBatch turns your Excel sheet into one .vcf file. Open it from AirDrop, Files or Mail and iOS adds every contact at once.\nLink in bio.',
    linkedin_post: 'iPhone users asked how SyncBatch works without Google Contacts.\n\nIt builds one .vcf file from your spreadsheet. Open it on the iPhone (AirDrop, Files or Mail) and iOS offers to add every contact at once. No app needed.\n{LINK}',
    x_post: 'Excel sheet → one .vcf → every contact on your iPhone. No app needed. {LINK}',
    hashtags: { instagram: ['SyncBatch', 'InovusLabs', 'iphonetips', 'ios', 'excel', 'productivity', 'techtips', 'kerala'], linkedin: ['SyncBatch', 'InovusLabs', 'iPhone'], x: ['iPhone'] },
    alt_text: 'SyncBatch card: one .vcf file for the whole list, opened on iPhone to add every contact.', angle_summary: 'iPhone users import a whole list through one vcf file' }),
  T({ id: 'fb-maker', eyebrow: 'Built at INOVUS LABS', headline: 'Why a student built', highlight: 'SyncBatch.', body: 'Teachers were typing 60+ numbers by hand every semester. That felt fixable.', points: ['Made at INOVUS LABS IEDC', 'Android and iPhone', 'First 10 contacts free'],
    template: 'usecase',
    instagram_caption: 'A small problem I kept seeing at college: teachers typing 60+ numbers by hand, every semester.\nSo I built SyncBatch at INOVUS LABS IEDC. 🛠️\nLink in bio.',
    linkedin_post: "I'm building SyncBatch at INOVUS LABS IEDC, Kristu Jyoti College.\n\nIt started with a small, repeated problem: teachers saving whole class lists by hand, one number at a time.\n\nNow you upload the sheet, check the preview, and save every contact at once.\n{LINK}",
    x_post: 'Built at INOVUS LABS: a tool that saves a whole Excel contact list to your phone at once. {LINK}',
    hashtags: { instagram: ['SyncBatch', 'InovusLabs', 'studentstartup', 'buildinpublic', 'kerala', 'kjcmt', 'iedc', 'makers'], linkedin: ['SyncBatch', 'InovusLabs', 'BuildInPublic', 'StudentStartup'], x: ['BuildInPublic'] },
    alt_text: 'SyncBatch card: Why a student built SyncBatch, made at INOVUS LABS IEDC.', angle_summary: 'maker story of why SyncBatch was built' }),
  T({ id: 'fb-trust', eyebrow: 'Your data', headline: 'Your contacts', highlight: "aren't stored.", body: 'Personal syncs go from your file to your own Google account through the official People API.', points: ['Preview before anything syncs', 'Official Google People API', 'Personal syncs not stored'],
    template: 'usecase',
    instagram_caption: 'Worried about giving a website your contacts? Fair. 🔒\nPersonal syncs go from your file to your own Google account through Google\'s official People API. SyncBatch doesn\'t keep them.\nLink in bio.',
    linkedin_post: 'A fair question about any contacts tool: where does my data go?\n\nFor personal syncs, SyncBatch reads your file, shows you a preview, and sends the contacts to your own Google account through Google\'s official People API. They are not stored.\n{LINK}',
    x_post: 'Personal syncs go straight to your own Google account and aren\'t stored. Preview first. {LINK}',
    hashtags: { instagram: ['SyncBatch', 'InovusLabs', 'privacy', 'dataprivacy', 'productivity', 'android', 'kerala', 'techtips'], linkedin: ['SyncBatch', 'InovusLabs', 'Privacy'], x: ['Privacy'] },
    alt_text: 'SyncBatch card: Your contacts are not stored; personal syncs go to your own Google account.', angle_summary: 'privacy: personal syncs are not stored' }),
  T({ id: 'fb-sales', eyebrow: 'Sales teams', headline: 'Know who is calling', highlight: 'back.', body: 'Save the lead list with a campaign label, then remove it when the campaign ends.', points: ['Label like [Lead Q4]', 'Duplicates skipped', 'Remove the list later'],
    template: 'usecase',
    instagram_caption: 'Missed call from an unknown number? It might be a lead. 📞\nSave your lead sheet with a label like [Lead Q4] so callbacks show who they are.\nLink in bio.',
    linkedin_post: 'Small sales teams lose callbacks to "unknown number".\n\nUpload the lead sheet to SyncBatch with a label like "[Lead Q4]", and callbacks show up with a name. When the campaign ends, remove the whole list by uploading the same sheet in delete mode.\n{LINK}',
    x_post: 'Lead sheet → phone contacts with a [Lead Q4] label, so callbacks show a name. {LINK}',
    hashtags: { instagram: ['SyncBatch', 'InovusLabs', 'sales', 'realestate', 'smallbusiness', 'leads', 'kerala', 'productivity'], linkedin: ['SyncBatch', 'InovusLabs', 'Sales'], x: ['Sales'] },
    alt_text: 'SyncBatch card for sales teams: label leads, skip duplicates, remove the list later.', angle_summary: 'sales leads labelled so callbacks show a name' }),
  T({ id: 'fb-remove', eyebrow: 'Quick tip', headline: 'Done with a list?', highlight: 'Remove it in one go.', body: 'Upload the same sheet in Delete contacts mode. Contacts are matched by phone number.', points: ['Upload the same sheet in Delete contacts mode to remove the whole batch from your phone.'],
    template: 'tip',
    instagram_caption: 'Course over? Event done? 🧹\nUpload the same sheet in Delete contacts mode and SyncBatch removes that whole batch from your phone, matched by number.\nLink in bio.',
    linkedin_post: 'Saving a big list is half the job. Removing it later is the other half.\n\nIn SyncBatch, upload the same sheet in "Delete contacts" mode and that batch is removed from your Google Contacts, matched by phone number.\n{LINK}',
    x_post: 'Done with a list? Upload the same sheet in delete mode and the whole batch is gone. {LINK}',
    hashtags: { instagram: ['SyncBatch', 'InovusLabs', 'techtips', 'androidtips', 'productivity', 'declutter', 'kerala', 'teachers'], linkedin: ['SyncBatch', 'InovusLabs', 'Productivity'], x: ['Productivity'] },
    alt_text: 'SyncBatch tip card: Done with a list? Remove it in one go by uploading the same sheet in delete mode.', angle_summary: 'removing a whole batch of contacts later' }),
];

// Unused posts first; prefer the planned layout. When all are used, start over.
const unused = BANK.filter((p) => !plan.usedFallbackIds.includes(p.id));
const pool = unused.length ? unused : BANK;
const pick = pool.find((p) => p.template === plan.template) || pool[0];

return [{
  json: {
    source: 'backup',
    note: `Backup post used because every free model failed. Last error: ${reason}`.slice(0, 400),
    template: pick.template,
    fallbackId: pick.id,
    post: pick,
  },
}];
